name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention (domain=player/battle UI, descriptor=action_menu_loop). Accurately describes the function: the player-side per-turn action UI that loops over target selection, pathfinding, walk animation, and the inline action submenu. No Ghidra address residue in the name; no trailing hex equal to its own/any data address.
purpose: Player-side per-turn action UI for the selected character: shows the movement-range highlight, lets the player pick a destination tile and an action (Attack/Spell/Item/Stand), animates the walk, and commits or cancels the action.
logic_summary: Copies the 16-byte (4-int) player_action_menu_state_template into a local menu_state; clears result_code (0x53C53)=0 and consequence_idx (0x51A8F)=0xFF. Computes the movement-cost class from char job_id (+0x20), overridden to 0x13 (flying) when fd2_check_char_status_immunity!=0, or to 0x10 (special) when portrait_id (+0x07)==0x1C; fetches the move-cost table. Allocates a path buffer of size range_remaining (combat_aux_block[0x14], +0x3B). Paints the ally threat overlay, flood-fills reachable tiles, blocks ally-occupied tiles, saves the origin cursor pos (saved_x/saved_y), repaints the side panel, then waits for a target. On cancel (-1): pan back to origin, free, return 1. Otherwise pathfinds to the destination; toggles anim_phase around panning back to origin. If the path has 0 steps (or 0xFF unreachable): loop the inline action submenu (have_moved=0) until non-zero; on commit run check_tile_event_post_action + free + return 1; on full cancel with result_code==0 return 0. If the path has steps: animate the walk, clear all facings, and for portrait_id not in {0x12,0x13,0x22} enable the "moved" submenu mode (menu_state[1]=1), then loop the inline action submenu (have_moved=1); on commit return the action code; on full cancel with result_code==0 revert position to the origin, pan, and return result_code(0). Common tail: mark_char_acted_this_turn, check_tile_event_post_action, return result_code.

params.name: char_idx
params.semantics: Index of the acting character in data_fd2_battle_runtime_char_array_ptr (used as runtime_char_array_ptr + char_idx). Passed by fd2_game_main_loop as the selected unit 'sel'.
params.reason: Accurately names the runtime-char-array index; no address residue, not the generic param_1.

returns.semantics: Action result code. 0 = cancelled / re-prompt (caller fd2_game_main_loop loops while ret==0); non-zero = action committed, advance turn. The committed value is either 1 (target-cancel or no-move-needed path that committed) or the action code returned by the inline submenu / data_fd2_battle_player_action_result_code.
